items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: I was with George Weir, I played -- I was with Vic up there I did all the solo work.

ctx.x: To play solos. Cause Wilbur, a guy that he didn't care if your solo was bad, he wouldn't even say a thing about it, he would let you go right ahead, he always had confidence in his men, to know that if they make a mistake, if they do bad one day, the next day they'd be better. That's the way he was, he gave me all the opportunity to -- in the world. And whenever I'd go to Europe, I'd always go there as a soloist, not as a lead man, they always gave me a chance in Europe as a soloist and I wanted to be a soloist,…

I was with George Weir, I played -- I was with Vic up there I did all the solo work. I was getting together, you know, and then you jump in the Latin band as a soloist, then you come out of there and you get it so I just made up my mind that I'm going to stay away from the Latin music, as much as possible. I hope. And stay with this so I could kind of get my mind together -- you know, back to where I want to be. I don't know what's happening. I -- everything seems to be working out all right.
